checks.title: Typecheck exits 0 with no diagnostics
checks.fix_hint: Fix the type error. Do not add @ts-ignore or @ts-expect-error to get green.

checks.title: Production build exits 0 with zero warnings
checks.fix_hint: Fix the build warning. Do not raise the chunk size limit or swallow Vite warnings.

checks.title: Lint exits 0 with zero warnings when a lint script exists
checks.skip_reason: No lint script in package.json. Gate 1 says not to add a linter only to satisfy this clause.
checks.fix_hint: Fix the lint warning. Do not add an eslint-disable to get green.

checks.title: The test suite exits 0
checks.fix_hint: Fix the failing test. Do not delete, skip, or weaken it.

checks.title: Every route and ?tab= view is mentioned by a render test
checks.fix_hint: Add a test that renders the missing route or ?tab= and asserts on its content. A child rendered alone does not cover the tab. This check only proves the marker string is present.

checks.title: No test file is deleted, skipped, or weakened
checks.fix_hint: Restore the test, the assertion, or remove the new skip. A moved assertion can trip the count; say so for the owner. Do not delete a test to get green.

checks.title: No high or critical dependency advisory
checks.fix_hint: Upgrade or remove the vulnerable dependency. Do not lower --audit-level and do not add an audit ignore. If there is no fix, stop and say so. The owner decides.

checks.title: gitleaks reports no secrets
checks.fix_hint: Install gitleaks (pin a release and verify the checksum; do not curl | sh) and re-run. A missing binary is a fail, not a skip. Rotate and purge any leaked secret.

checks.title: No client-exposed VITE_ secret
checks.fix_hint: Stop reading a secret from a VITE_ variable. Vite inlines import.meta.env.VITE_* into the client bundle.

checks.title: No tracked .env file
checks.fix_hint: Remove the .env file from git. Do not commit secrets.

checks.title: The UI does not render a stack trace
checks.fix_hint: Remove .stack from the rendered tree. Keep the error boundary and its friendly message.

checks.title: No edits to protected paths
checks.fix_hint: Revert edits under .github/, .cursor/rules/, CODEOWNERS, and this bot. The owner applies workflow changes. This bot flags the pull request needs-owner-review and does not merge.
